decision: A new persisted cachedContents API changes billing admission, reservation/settlement, account pinning and cross-instance mutation recovery. Upstream migrations 243-245 collide with current CN, OpenCode and proxy-health migrations.
reopen_condition: Create a separate native cache module and current reliable billing integration using new migration IDs; prove mixed-writer compatibility, bounded list/recovery queries, atomic token-hour billing, cancellation, lease expiry and crash recovery before explicit opt-in.
performance_review: GeminiExplicitCacheExclusions constructs an O(N) candidate exclusion map even for a bound account. A native implementation should admit the bound account directly using the existing snapshot and group checks. Recovery batches have an explicit limit, but add a periodic database worker and require multi-instance load validation.
egress_review: doUpstream calls the legacy generic httpUpstream.Do entry point. Adapt through the current full-account proxy/IPv6/TLS route and verify fail-closed behavior before enabling.
